items.q: Well, different guys I'd met in different bands, yes. ... you met -- well now keep going, Sonny, one day, and you never can tell, you know.

ctx.x: Did you know any people in New York at that time?

Well, different guys I'd met in different bands, yes. I did know, and it was celebrities. When I had met them in Philadelphia and other towns, yes, my name is Hemingwye (sic), you know, the English, the English. This is Joe, Little Joey. You know, you met -- well now keep going, Sonny, one day, and you never can tell, you know. You know, that whole thing. And so you keep moving.
